name: PancakeSlicer
description: PancakeSlicer is a self-hostable, web-based slicer for non-planar 3D printing, built on the OrcaSlicer engine. One central instance gives a whole household or makerspace a single shared set of printers, filaments and profiles reachable from any browser, with dynamic profiles that adapt to nozzle size and layer height instead of a profile per combination.

notes.text: Non-planar slicing is experimental and can damage a printer. Review the G-code preview before every print and supervise non-planar jobs.

The service has no authentication by default and printer connections default to LAN. Anyone who can reach http://<IP>:6868 can add printers and start prints. Before exposing this somewhere where that might be a problem, either: uncomment and give a value to ORCA_WEB_BEARER_TOKEN in /opt/pancakeslicer_data/pancakeslicer.env for the built-in auth then restart the service, or put it behind an authed reverse proxy.
